acceptanceCriteria: Before execution, the exact three owner-selected Core jobs, corpus, strongest adequate fixed baseline, thresholds, exclusions and invalidation rules are preregistered and sealed.
The treatment has zero treatment-only critical misses and zero false complete-evidence verdicts on designated missing-evidence cases.
Complete task cost, failures, retries and latency are measured against the fixed baseline, and receipt-producing sealed-benchmark evidence binds the immutable corpus, candidate commit and results.
Any retained cost-reduction claim meets its accepted threshold; otherwise the result stays measured without a savings claim.
body: Evaluate the complete verified workflow, not packet size or isolated command speed. Preserve losing runs and all NOT_OBSERVED dimensions.
title: Measure correctness and complete cost of the daily loop
